finding: B-011 IS ALREADY RESOLVED FOR THE RUN COMMAND

finding_detail.audit_assumption: The audit (production-truth-source-implementation-audit.json, CMF-02) assumed evidence_dir creation was gated by --metrics because _create_metrics_session() checks metrics_enabled and returns early if not enabled (lines 32-37 of __main__.py). The audit assumed _create_metrics_session() was the only path to evidence_dir creation for run command.
finding_detail.actual_code_path_for_run_command: The 'run' command handler at __main__.py lines 353-449 does NOT call _create_metrics_session(). Instead it calls run_pipeline() directly (line 393). run_pipeline() in runner.py lines 1207-1208 creates evidence_dir unconditionally: 'evidence_dir = run_dir / "evidence"' and 'evidence_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)'.
finding_detail.evidence_dir_creation_location: src/plugin_examples/runner.py lines 1207-1208 — unconditional, regardless of metrics flag
finding_detail._create_metrics_session_usage: _create_metrics_session() is called for non-run commands: discover-lowcode, validate-publish-targets, resolve-repo-access, probe-publish-permissions, publish-pr, merge-pr, release-status, render-root-readme, publish-readme, sync-taskcard-docs. These commands use a session-level run_id (not a pipeline run_id) and write evidence to metrics-{command}-{family}-{ts}/evidence/.
finding_detail.impact_on_b011: B-011 is NOT a blocker for the run command. Evidence_dir is created unconditionally by runner.py for every run command invocation, whether or not --metrics is enabled.
finding_detail.residual_concern: For non-run commands, evidence_dir creation IS gated by --metrics (via _create_metrics_session). However, non-run commands don't execute the full pipeline, so their 'evidence_dir' is a metrics session directory, not a pipeline evidence directory. This is architecturally correct — non-run commands don't generate the FAMILY_SCOPED_EVIDENCE_FILES.

runner_py_evidence_dir_creation.code:
run_dir = repo_root / 'workspace' / 'runs' / run_id
run_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
evidence_dir = run_dir / 'evidence'
evidence_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

main_py_run_command_handler.note: run command handler calls run_pipeline() at line 393 without going through _create_metrics_session(). No evidence_dir creation in this block — runner.py handles it.

remediation_decision.remi_005_status: COMPLETED — review confirms B-011 is not a real blocker for run command
remediation_decision.remi_006_status: NOT_REQUIRED — evidence_dir is already unconditionally created in runner.py for run command

implications.run_to_run_comparison: Run-to-run comparison (B-002/REM-016) IS viable without source change — prior run evidence_dir exists at workspace/runs/{prior_run_id}/evidence/ after any run command.
implications.b002_can_proceed: B-002 (run-to-run comparison) can be implemented without first fixing B-011, since B-011 is already resolved.
implications.non_run_commands: Non-run commands (discover-lowcode, publish-pr, etc.) do not generate FAMILY_SCOPED_EVIDENCE_FILES — their evidence_dir gating by --metrics is architecturally correct and should not be changed.
